SELECT sh.id, sh.scheduled_at, sh.title, sh.purpose, NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) AS total_target_count, NVL(sh.success_count, 0) AS success_count, NVL(sh.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count, CASE WHEN NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (NVL(sh.success_count, 0) * 100.0) / sh.total_target_count END AS success_rate, sh.estimated_saving, sh.status FROM send_history sh
ORDER BY
sh.scheduled_at ASC NULLS LAST, sh.id ASC
NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) DESC, sh.scheduled_at DESC NULLS LAST, sh.id DESC
CASE WHEN NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (NVL(sh.success_count, 0) * 100.0) / sh.total_target_count END DESC, sh.scheduled_at DESC NULLS LAST, sh.id DESC
sh.scheduled_at DESC NULLS LAST, sh.id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, channel_type AS label FROM channel WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY channel_type
SELECT id, name AS label FROM tag WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT purpose FROM send_history WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND purpose IS NOT NULL ORDER BY purpose
